resources.string: Connect the Thor and the other device to the same Wi-Fi network.
Your chosen folder is available on the local network.
Send and receive files from a computer or phone in your chosen folder. Sharing stays active until you stop it.
Use an FTP client on the other device. Use a trusted network: FTP does not encrypt transfers. Existing files are never overwritten and cannot be deleted remotely.
Show FTP in the navigation bar
